core_resolved_debt.title: SQLite WAL Multi-Threading & DbActor Async Serialization Queue
core_resolved_debt.root_cause: Concurrent Tokio tasks simultaneously borrowed SQLite write connections via r2d2, causing SQLITE_BUSY deadlocks and RISK-01 silent drop turn defect.
core_resolved_debt.resolution: Dedicated OS thread 'liva-db-writer-actor' owning single SQLite writer connection via 1024-bounded mpsc queue with backpressure and periodic 15m PASSIVE checkpointing.

core_resolved_debt.title: SQLite Vector Upsert Transaction Atomicity & Rollback Protection
core_resolved_debt.root_cause: Multi-table vector upsert across vectors_meta, vec_idx, and vectors_fts was non-atomic, leaving orphaned rows when downstream quantization or FTS failed.
core_resolved_debt.resolution: Implemented check_vector_dim validation gate and conn.is_autocommit() transaction wrapper enforcing full rollback on sub-step error.

core_resolved_debt.title: WebRTC VAD Memory Bounds (32,000 Samples Clamp)
core_resolved_debt.root_cause: PCM residual_buffer could expand unbounded during network lag or audio chunk burst, causing memory leaks and multi-second latency.
core_resolved_debt.resolution: Clamped residual buffer to MAX_RESIDUAL_CAPACITY = 32_000 samples (2.0s audio @ 16kHz) with FIFO drain and explicit reset() clean-up.

core_resolved_debt.title: Panic Elimination Across STT, TTS, LLM, WebRTC, WebSocket
core_resolved_debt.root_cause: Raw .unwrap() and .expect() calls triggered cascading process panics on lock poisoning, missing Kokoro voices, or transient socket resets.
core_resolved_debt.resolution: Replaced mutex unwrap with .unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()), converted fallible APIs to Result, added Kokoro empty fallback and 50ms websocket retry backoff.

core_resolved_debt.title: Multi-Model Idle Memory Reclamation (VieNeu ~500MB & Parakeet ~2.4GB)
core_resolved_debt.root_cause: VieNeu and Parakeet heavy ONNX weights remained resident permanently in RAM, consuming 3.5GB to 4.0GB even during idle hours.
core_resolved_debt.resolution: Implemented check_idle_unload and unload_sessions to drop ONNX sessions after 300s of inactivity via non-blocking try_lock() sweep in boot.rs.

core_resolved_debt.title: Lazy Model Reloading Without Audio Latency Spikes
core_resolved_debt.root_cause: Synchronous on-demand reload of heavy ONNX models while holding Mutex froze the audio pipeline and UI thread for 1.5s to 3.0s.
core_resolved_debt.resolution: Isolated synthesis_plan clone outside of locks, offloaded heavy inference and reload to tokio::task::spawn_blocking, with seamless Piper fallback tier.

test_evidence.function: Live Socket Gateway Connection Suite (8/8 pass)

core_resolved_debt.title: Nghị định 13/2023/NĐ-CP Compliance Redaction (CCCD, SĐT, STK)
core_resolved_debt.root_cause: Naïve regex patterns caused severe false-positives, redacting system timestamps, git hashes, or technical tokens.
core_resolved_debt.resolution: Engineered SecretScrubber with 12 sequential high-performance compiled regex steps, context-bound bank account filtering, and recursive JSON sanitization.

core_resolved_debt.title: Desktop UI Audio Playback Event Cleanup & Authorization
core_resolved_debt.root_cause: audio_play_started and audio_play_finished events emitted by WidgetApp caused authorization warnings and security ambiguity.
core_resolved_debt.resolution: Explicitly registered events under WIDGET_COMMANDS ACL, configured fail-closed behavior for remote clients, and handled telemetry as clean no-op.

core_resolved_debt.title: Complete Eradication of Scratch Scripts (.cjs)
core_resolved_debt.root_cause: Temporary CommonJS scripts (check.cjs, fix_widget.cjs, patch_widgetapp.cjs) polluted repo and created build-time risks.
core_resolved_debt.resolution: Deleted all temporary scratch scripts, standardized linting into package.json scripts and Vitest suites, with CI audit checks.

core_resolved_debt.title: IPC Dead Branch Pruning & Bootstrap Optimization in useGateway.ts
core_resolved_debt.root_cause: useGateway.ts retained dead IPC branches and flooded the backend with unprivileged Dashboard requests when initializing Widget.
core_resolved_debt.resolution: Pruned obsolete branches in mapTauriResponse, partitioned bootstrap into 7 minimal Widget commands vs Dashboard, and enforced 5m stream cleanup.

core_resolved_debt.title: Graceful FTS5 Fallback for Vector Search
core_resolved_debt.root_cause: Missing vec0.dll caused init_schemas to abort with 'no such module: vec0' when creating vec_idx virtual table, causing process termination during boot in environments lacking sqlite-vec binaries.
core_resolved_debt.resolution: Implemented has_sqlite_vec capability detection: when vec0 fails to load, vec_idx table creation is skipped, conversation_turn plaintext is retained in vectors_fts, and vector search gracefully degrades to pure FTS5 BM25 keyword matching with logged warnings without process termination.

core_resolved_debt.title: Compile-Time & Release Guard for Default Encryption Key
core_resolved_debt.root_cause: DEFAULT_ENCRYPTION_KEY was permitted as a development fallback without compile-time/runtime release guard, risking accidental production deployments with public insecure encryption keys.
core_resolved_debt.resolution: Enforced strict release guard: release builds panic-abort if DEFAULT_ENCRYPTION_KEY is used in EncryptionEngine::new, in-memory databases generate ephemeral random 32-byte keys in release mode, and check_release_key_guard provides deterministic verification while keeping debug developer convenience intact.

core_resolved_debt.title: WebView Security Hardening & Command Channel Segregation
core_resolved_debt.root_cause: withGlobalTauri was set to true exposing window.__TAURI__ globally to DOM scripts, and desktop capability permissions were unsegregated, lacking strict isolation between widget and dashboard windows.
core_resolved_debt.resolution: Set withGlobalTauri to false, migrated setup wizard to a Vite-bundled ES module, registered 6 banking commands in build.rs with exclusive dashboard capabilities, and enforced capability assertions in capability_policy.rs.

core_resolved_debt.title: Experimental Feature Gating for Sandbox Modules
core_resolved_debt.root_cause: evolution and evolution::sandbox modules were included in default library compilation despite having zero runtime call sites, causing un-sandboxed host test executions during default cargo test runs.
core_resolved_debt.resolution: Gated evolution module under #[cfg(feature = 'experimental')] in src/lib.rs and src/evolution/mod.rs, and gated tests/llm_code_agent_tests.rs, ensuring default builds exclude sandbox while --features experimental enables full compilation and testing.

intentional_residual_debt.title: WebSocket 8002 Identity and Authorization
intentional_residual_debt.risk_note: Loopback remote clients do not require bearer token because they are constrained to a strict 9-command allowlist (chat/voice/health). Non-loopback clients require shared bearer secret. Single-user beta threat model considers co-located processes outside security boundary.
intentional_residual_debt.planned_remediation: Transition to mTLS device certificates and TPM/DPAPI identity for multi-tenant network exposure.

intentional_residual_debt.title: Intent Routing & Confirmation Step for Physical IoT Actions

intentional_residual_debt.planned_remediation: Mandate an interactive UI confirmation modal before triggering physical IoT commands when external hardware drivers are wired.
